messages:
nina-cs: Quick heads-up 1 min ago AstraWell hit regional rate limits during a partner demo. Theyre asking for a short-lived throughput lift and IP allowlist for EU and APAC while their SRE finishes onboarding scripts. Case opened: 812900. Need fast triage.

carlos-net: What QPS and CIDR ranges? Which edges to route to?

nina-cs: Case 812900  requests: EU -> 3200 qps (currently ~900), APAC -> 1400 qps (currently ~420). Window: 24h starting now, then auto-revoke. Egress prefixes: 20.100.0.0/16 and 52.23.160.0/20. They asked for eu-west + apac-sg edges and that we capture per-region request counts during the window.

carlos-net: I can add ephemeral L7 allowlist entries and tag them. TTL=86400s (24h). No peering required for ephemeral. Will annotate the case: "auto-revoke 24h (2024-10-02T09:00:00Z)". Applying in ~3m.

asha-eng: Which route/model? For demo bursts set max_concurrency=8, cap max_tokens=300, and enable prefix caching. Recommend fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 to avoid user-facing failures if the 70b saturates. Also suggest warming KV cache with their sample prompts.

nina-cs: Route: aw-chat-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. AstraWell accepts fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4. They also asked that we add a custom header check (x-customer-token) for demo traffic only.

ryan-ops: Can we gate demo traffic by header? We can add an L7 rule matching x-customer-token and only allow listed CIDRs. That reduces blast radius.

carlos-net: Implementing L7 rule with header match + CIDR map. Tag 'customer:astrawell' and set TTL 86400. Rolling apply now.

deploy-bot: Ticket 812900-ephemeral-allowlist created by nina-cs. Assigned: carlos-net. SLA: 3h.

carlos-net: Done  rules applied. Verified 200 from 20.100.12.5 hitting eu-west gateway with header present. Auto-revoke scheduled.

asha-eng: Ran a small synthetic check under demo load: p50 92ms, p95 410ms during a 200qps pilot slice. Enabled prefix cache and warmed KV with demo prompts. Set runtime fallback to 13b when queueing > 3%.

tom-sales: FYI renewal is in 26 days for AstraWell  this demo is high priority for upsell. Please paste smoke curl + perf snapshot to the case so I can share with AE.

ryan-ops: Pasted smoke example to case and to customer. Curl we used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -H "x-customer-token: demo-astrawell" \ 
 -d '{"route":"aw-chat-prod","input":"health check","max_tokens":10}'
```

nina-cs: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: Notifying AstraWell their test window is live and scheduling a 30-min enablement check-in at 2024-10-02T07:30:00Z. I added Renewal Watch to case 812900. Will capture any post-demo feedback in the case.
